data.one_liner: iOS implementation of the image_picker plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides the iOS-specific implementation for picking images and videos from the device storage or capturing them with the camera using the image_picker ecosystem.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter application targeting iOS and need to allow users to select images or videos.
You are using the endorsed image_picker package and need its iOS backend support.
avoid_when: You are building a non-Flutter application.
You do not need support for the iOS platform.
strengths: Automatically included as an endorsed federated plugin when using image_picker.
Native integration with iOS photo library and camera APIs.
weaknesses: Not intended to be used directly unless implementing custom platform-specific extensions.
data.setup_notes: Endorsed plugin; usually automatically included via image_picker without adding it manually to pubspec.yaml unless accessing APIs directly.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main endorsed federated package that automatically uses this iOS implementation.
